steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (paginate)
liked_ids = set()
page = 0
while True:
    liked = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_response['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not liked:
        break
    for song in liked:
        liked_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(liked) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_ids)
print("Current song 93 liked?", 93 in liked_ids)
